IGUI_PD_BreedDesc_cat: Not a dog with worse numbers: an animal that simply does not have some of the jobs. A cat never fights the dead, is never posted to a pen, and only breeds with other cats. It hunts rodents and rabbits, and leaves deer alone. Your own animals are never prey: it will not touch a chicken, or anything in a pen. What it gives you instead is warning: it notices the dead further out than any other companion, and it is quiet about everything else. The hardest animal in the family to train, and independent with it: the bond fades faster than a dog's if you neglect it. Every so often it spots a rodent, drops everything and goes after it, ignoring your orders until it is done; only Come brings it back. Common in homes, and turns up at pet shops and veterinary clinics.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_CatEye_desc: Your cat sees what you cannot. While it is fed, watered and bonded to you, the dark stops hiding what you are searching for: foraging at night works close to how it does by day.
IGUI_PD_PauseGrowthTip_cat: Kittens that never grow up? Wish real life had that toggle :D
IGUI_PD_BadFood_cat: Bad for cats. Eating this makes it sick and breaks its trust.
IGUI_PD_AlertFullDesc_cat: Full watch over the whole sentinel range. A quiet growl for distant or few zombies; a loud hiss for close, many or visible ones, and that hiss can draw zombies (the trade-off). The default.
IGUI_PD_AlertQuietDesc_cat: Stealth watch: only a small nearby ring, and never more than a quiet growl and a halo, no loud hiss, no noise that draws zombies. A discreet heads-up that won't give away your position.
IGUI_PD_HuntModeDesc_cat: When on, your %1 tracks small game while following you and, once trained enough, chases it down: killing rodents and rabbits for you. Hunting is a rural activity (you find game in forests and the countryside, not in town). The cost is symmetric: the cat leaves your side and is exposed, the chase can draw zombies, it can wander off, and hunting works up an appetite. Off by default; toggle it per cat.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoDesc_cat: Send the cat to a chosen tile and have it hold there.
IGUI_PD_TrickDistractDesc_cat: The cat yowls on purpose to pull zombies toward itself, then falls back to you. It costs stress, and the horde goes for the cat.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffDesc_cat: Hold an item and the cat memorizes its scent. From then on it warns you and goes to it whenever one is nearby.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchDesc_cat: Hold an item and the cat memorizes it. Every time you sleep it goes out looking on its own and can come back with one, stowed in the saddlebags. Once a day, and the rarer the item the longer it takes. Needs saddlebags.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffStopDesc_cat: The cat forgets the memorized scent and stops warning you about it.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchStopDesc_cat: The cat forgets what it was looking for and stops going out while you sleep.
IGUI_PD_TrickGotoPick_cat: Click where to send the cat. Right click cancels.
IGUI_PD_TrickSniffNoItem_cat: Hold the item you want the cat to smell.
IGUI_PD_TrickFetchNoItem_cat: Hold the item you want the cat to look for.
IGUI_PD_AlertGroup_cat: Your %1 hisses! A group of zombies!
IGUI_PD_Refused_nodata_cat: There is no record of that cat to call it back.
IGUI_PD_KennelStatusNoData_cat: No record yet, visit this cat once
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Sick_desc_cat: You fed it something cats shouldn't eat. Your cat is intoxicated and feeling ill.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Weak_desc_cat: Your cat is weak: it has gone a long time without protein. It obeys less.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Hunger_desc_cat: Your cat is hungry. Feed it before its health starts to suffer.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Thirst_desc_cat: Your cat is thirsty. Give it water before its health starts to suffer.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Rested_desc_cat: You slept soundly with your cat curled up beside you. For a while you feel calm and rested: panic, stress, sadness and boredom fade faster, and you tire more slowly.
IGUI_PD_Moodle_Grief_desc_cat: Your cat is gone. The grief weighs on you, and it will only fade with time.
